Select exact IC50 activities for human BTK (CHEMBL5251) where compounds have a canonical SMILES and the activity has a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures (INNER JOIN for structures). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
